'''Mitt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Budpock]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], where he worked for the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|distributor]] [[Threnda]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Mitt was repairing a [[CLL-6 binary load lifter droid]] in Threnda's warehouse when the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] burst in and destroyed Threnda's stocks of the spice [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] with a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]. The Trandoshan subsequently used a [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguisher]] to put out the [[Fire/Legends|flames]] produced by the blast.
